title: TAP Capability Registry
description: Schema for tap_auth/tap_auth.capabilities.json — the declarative source of truth for TAP's authorization vocabulary. A mandatory top-level description states what/why; each capability declares a namespaced name, a human-readable description, and a risk level. additionalProperties:false catches typos and rogue fields. Name uniqueness is enforced by the loader (tap_auth/capabilities.py). See spec-tap-auth-v0 req-tap-auth-capabilities.

description.description: What this file is and why it exists (mandatory — config that grants authority must explain itself).

capabilities.description: The capability vocabulary, in declared order.

description.description: Human-readable meaning, stored on the Capability row.

description_json.description: Optional structured context, flowed to Capability.description_json (queryable alongside the prose description for AI/security reasoning).

risk.description: Risk/classification metadata, queryable from the DB.
